_comment: Briscola locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action token '[play X]', the card labels (A, 2..7, J, Q, K), the suit symbols (carried in the {card}/{trump_card} slots), or numeric counts/points/scores. The '(TRUMP)' marker text may be localized.

_slots.{trump_suit}: The trump suit symbol (♠♥♦♣) - do not translate
_slots.{trump_card}: The trump card label, e.g. '7♠' - do not translate
_slots.{card}: A card label, e.g. 'A♥' - do not translate
_slots.{max_pos}: The highest legal card position in the player's hand
_slots.{count}: The number of cards a player holds
_slots.{pos}: A card's position number in the hand
_slots.{points}: A number of points (card value or accumulated score)
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered score line, or the final per-player score block
_slots.{winner}: The player number who won the trick or game
_slots.{tricks}: A number of tricks won by a player
_slots.{deck_count}: Number of cards left in the deck

game.start: An fara wasan Briscola! Trump kwat da wando: {trump_suit} (Katin Trump: {trump_card})

prompt.intro: Kuna wasa Briscola - Mai kunnawa {player_id}. Manufa: Lashe dabaru kuma tattara mafi yawan maki (adadi 120 a cikin bene). Card Points: A = 11, 3 = 10, K = 4, Q = 3, J = 2, wasu = 0 Card Power: A > 3 > K > Q > J > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 2 Katunan Trump sun doke katunan da ba na trump ba tare da la'akari da iko ba. Aiki: '[play X]' inda X shine matsayi (1-{max_pos}) na katin a hannunka

trick.empty: Babu katunan da aka buga har yanzu wannan abin zamba.

turn.trump_info_deck: Kayan Trump: {trump_suit} │ Katunan da aka bari a cikin bene: {deck_count}
turn.board: {hand} {trick} Scores: {scores} {trump_info} Yi wasa da katin ta amfani da [play X]

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yi amfani da [play X] inda X shine matsayin katin (1, 2, 3, da sauransu)
invalid_move.out_of_range: Matsayin katin mara inganci. Kuna da {count} katunan (1-{count})

action.trick_win: Mai kunnawa {winner} ya ci nasara da dabarar tare da {card} kuma ya sami maki {points}!

outcome.head: Game Over! Mai kunnawa {winner} ya ci nasara tare da {points} maki! Sakamakon karshe: {scores}
